scope: SLA apply, invalidation, model ownership, and physical transformation contracts. Native assertion validation is required.

mutants.description: Force the equal model-object-list path to be skipped; unchanged apply must remain unchanged.
Do not request model-object replacement for full geometry correction changes.
Remove the full invalidation guard from model synchronization; transformed geometry must still be rebuilt.
Ignore SLA transform differences when deciding whether to replace a print object.
Ignore model drain-hole edits; drill-hole invalidation regression must fail.
Ignore changed print-object instance records; scaled geometry regression must fail.
Ignore the rebuilt print-object vector; object extension/deletion must fail.
Remove drill-hole dependent-step invalidation; drain-hole edit contract must fail.
Use linear rather than squared scale in the x component of the inverse-transpose normal transform.
Reverse the hole height compensation; transformed drain-hole height contract must fail.
Send support geometry changes to pad invalidation instead of support-tree invalidation.
Send pad geometry changes to slice-support invalidation instead of pad invalidation; the completed pad must remain stale.
Skip the raster-only merge invalidation; exposure change must leave the completed print incorrectly marked finished.
Send slice-closing-radius changes to support-point invalidation instead of object-slice invalidation.
